name: Pattern Printer (Holographic Press)
description: An interactive sci-fi pattern printer. The player edits a small floating holographic motif grid on the tilted print-head console (touch cells to paint with the selected ink); the machine symmetrises that fragment through one of the 17 wallpaper groups and extrudes the result live — a glowing sheet that scrolls up out of the print head AND a carpet pressed onto the floor. Fuses the editor (pattern_maker_station) with the machine (pattern_loom): you touch the cartridge, the press re-prints the world. Reuses WallpaperGroups.get_symmetric_color + PatternSim.PALETTES.
theoreticalGrounding: A pattern is a program plus a fragment. Hand the player the fragment (a 5x5 painted motif) and the press (the symmetry group), and they discover that structure comes from constraint, not complexity. The wallpaper group is the program; the printer runs it on whatever you paint.

pattern_machine_b.name: Pattern Printer (Holographic Press)
pattern_machine_b.description: Dark machine frame with emissive accent rails, a print head with a glowing extrusion slot + spinning feed roller, and a tilted holographic edit console. Touch the holo cells to paint; INK buttons pick the color, CYCLE advances the wallpaper group, SEED rerolls the motif, CLEAR blanks it, PRINT flashes the head. Output updates live as a vertical printed sheet scrolling up and a floor carpet scrolling forward. DNA: group (p1..p6m), palette, motif_seed, motif_size, density, machine dimensions.
pattern_machine_b.qfep_connection: F_order: the 17 wallpaper groups as an interactive manufacturing program — the player edits the fragment, constraint multiplies it into endless printed fabric.
